WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), above_average AS (
  SELECT store_id, payment_total,
         AVG(payment_total) OVER () AS avg_rental_payment
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT store_id,
       SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total,
       AVG(payment_total - avg_rental_payment) AS avg_amount_above_average
FROM above_average
WHERE payment_total > avg_rental_payment
GROUP BY store_id;
